item.title: Manchester City agree Omar Marmoush loan to Spurs with initial £50m obligation to buy
item.summary: City agree £52m Nico González sale to Newcastle Club expected to make Enzo Fernández bid Manchester City have agreed to loan Omar Marmoush to Tottenham for the season, with an obligation to buy the forward for an initial £50m, and struck a deal to sell Nico González to Newcastle for £52m. Marmoush is to have a medical at Spurs, who have agreed to pay up to £10m in add-ons, with half of that guaranteed. Next summer the 27-year-old is to sign a four-year contract with a one-year option. City are not due to give a sell-on fee to Eintracht Frankfurt, from whom they bought the Egyptian in January 2025. Continue reading...
